name: 불 · 과열 휘두르기
description: Flat side view in the picture plane; stays in profile. Wrench lifts behind the head, then chops forward in one big vertical arc with an orange-red flame crescent, returns to the input pose.

name: 얼음 · 서리 볼트
description: Flat side view in the picture plane; stays in profile. Far empty arm extends forward with an open palm, three cyan ice shards fly forward, returns to the input pose.

name: 전기 · 도전 스패너
description: Flat side view in the picture plane; stays in profile. Wrench pulls back low and thrusts forward like a spear, returns to the input pose. Lightning is drawn by the game beam.

name: 바람 · 압축 돌진
